description: Activity and availability of the Seedit communities monitored by Bitsocial.

options.content:
Network overview  ·  5chan boards  ·  Seedit communities

Activity and availability of the 10 communities in Seedit's default subscriptions.

panels.description: Communities whose latest fetch succeeded and whose latest update is less than 2 hours old.

targets.expr: sum(((max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_seconds_since_updated_at{client_id="seedit"}) < bool 7200) * max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="seedit"})) or (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="seedit"}) * 0))

panels.title: Communities online

panels.description: All-time posts and comments, counted like the 5chan homepage.

targets.expr: sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_all_post_count{client_id="seedit"})) + sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_all_reply_count{client_id="seedit"}))

panels.title: Total posts

panels.description: Posts and comments from the last 24 hours in communities the monitor can currently fetch.

targets.expr: sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_day_post_count{client_id="seedit"}) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="seedit"}) == 1)) + sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_day_reply_count{client_id="seedit"}) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="seedit"}) == 1))

panels.title: Posts (24h)

panels.description: Addresses that posted in the last 7 days, counted like the 5chan homepage: summed per community, so an address active in several communities counts once for each.

targets.expr: sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_week_active_user_count{client_id="seedit"}))

panels.title: Current users

panels.description: Posts and comments from the last 24 hours, as reported by each community's own stats.

targets.expr: sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_day_post_count{client_id="seedit"}) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="seedit"}) == 1))

sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_day_reply_count{client_id="seedit"}) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="seedit"}) == 1))

panels.title: Posts (24h)

panels.description: Addresses that posted within the last 24 hours, 7 days (current users) and 30 days, summed per community.

targets.expr: sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_day_active_user_count{client_id="seedit"}) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="seedit"}) == 1))
sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_week_active_user_count{client_id="seedit"}))
sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_month_active_user_count{client_id="seedit"}))

panels.title: Active users

panels.description: Cumulative posts and comments, plus unique posting addresses summed per community.

targets.expr: sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_all_post_count{client_id="seedit"}))
sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_all_reply_count{client_id="seedit"}))
sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_all_active_user_count{client_id="seedit"}))

panels.title: All-time totals

panels.description: Every community in Seedit's default subscriptions. A community is offline when the monitor cannot fetch it or its latest update is more than 2 hours old. Current users are addresses that posted in the last 7 days. Click a column header to sort; click a community to open it on Seedit.
